name: J’Vanay
note:
J’Vanay, you told me KINN launches this weekend and you’ve got 200+ people waiting to hear from you. So I said it out loud to Henway, the way I’d tell a friend, and recorded what happened.

WaitlistMailer is yours. It holds your list, writes each person their own email, and walks you through sending a batch at a time so you don’t land in spam. Sending to everyone at once from your own address needs an email service, so I took it to Bolt to show you that part too. Everything you need to finish it is below.

Congrats on the launch.
appLine: A personal email for everyone on your waitlist, a batch at a time.
lede: What I said, the app it hatched, and Bolt picking it up to do the real sending. Cut down to the moments that matter.
ogDesc: WaitlistMailer: a personal email for everyone on your waitlist, a batch at a time. The app, and the message to finish it in Bolt.

handoff.title: Finish it in Bolt
handoff.intro: Henway built the part that works on its own. Bolt adds what needs a server: real batch sending from your own address, delivery tracking, and an unsubscribe list that remembers.
steps: Open Bolt and start a new project in your own account.
Tap Copy below and paste it as your first message. It carries the working app and exactly what to add.
When Bolt asks for “secrets” (RESEND_API_KEY and friends), that’s expected. Sign up at resend.com, add your domain there, and paste the keys into Bolt’s settings, never into the chat.
The sample message is signed “Jordan”. Change it to you before anything goes out.

checklist.title: So it lands in the inbox, not spam
items: Send from your own domain (like you@findmykinn.com), verified in Resend. Resend shows you the records to add.
Send yourself one test at a Gmail address first, and check which tab it lands in.
Send in batches: about 50, wait a few hours, then the rest.
Keep it personal and mostly text: one link, no big images.
Keep the unsubscribe line in every email.
